author: PlayDead666
quote: Faithful remake of a timeless classic, feels like 1998 again. The game is improved over the original but feels like my nostalgia remembers. Experiencing this game all over again with my children is like a gift from Nintendo.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: PlayDead666
quote: $8 USD monthly subscription for a single player game just to unlock a garage and a car that should have been part of the game or a token one time dlc fee. You've gone too far Rockstar, this is some next level predatory tactics that disrespects every one of your player base.
